companion.label: AI study companion
companion.title: Study companion
companion.description: Ask questions about what you are reading. Answers are drawn from the lessons and the Bible text in this app.
companion.prompt2: Help me pray about today's lesson
companion.prompt3: How can I put this into practice?
companion.offTitle: The study companion is turned off
companion.offBody: An administrator can turn it on in organisation settings.
companion.disclaimer: This is an AI, and it can be wrong. Your conversations are private. Nothing is shared unless you ask and your mentor approves.
companion.canned: In this demo, replies are prepared examples rather than live AI.
companion.placeholder: Ask about a passage, a lesson or something you're wondering
companion.savedPrivate: Saved as a private entry. Only you can see it.
companion.shareBody: Your mentor will read this reply and decide whether it should be added to your reflection.
companion.shareSentBody: Your mentor will review it. You'll hear back when they decide.
companion.shareWhereHelp: If approved, the reply appears on this reflection, labelled as AI.
companion.noSharedReflections: You have no reflections shared with your mentor yet.
companion.approvalsBody: Nothing from the study companion is shared until you approve it.
companion.reviewHelp: You can edit the reply before approving it. It stays labelled as AI-assisted.
companion.approvalsEmptyBody: Requests from your mentees will appear here.
